🧳 A traveler swears Emberhold, northwest, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. Emberhold is starving.)

📺 The Wrong Map. The System hands you a map to buried alien rations. Exactly one thing on it is a lie. Find the lie, find the food.

People have been hurt in this one. Not always.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A map of the valley, drawn in alien ink that moves when you aren't looking. Buried alien rations, marked with an X. Exactly one thing on the map is a lie.

You and Betty have until the light goes.

The veterans who've read its maps before just say "don't trust the blue." They won't say why.

📺 Windfall. A storm dropped a fortune — fruit, game, a stranded fish haul — and every bit of it is rotting on camera. Beat the rot: eat, dry, haul. The clock is spoilage.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The storm's leavings, spread across the meadow: berry bushes stripped and scattered, a downed deer, a stranded fish haul flopping in a cut-off pool, fruit everywhere.

All of it is rotting. Right now. On camera. The System, cheerful: "BEAT THE ROT. EAT, DRY, HAUL. THE CLOCK IS SPOILAGE."

Betty saw something last night at the far traps. Told it twice.

DAWN: "It was big. I heard it breathing. I hid. I don't know what it was."

NOON: "It was BIG — came right at the traps, I stood my ground, it saw me and turned. I think I scared it."
